swap.name: Cooling
swap.blurb: The first puzzle on the domain engine: Cooling, written as a puzzle document and its rules.
swap.how_to: Swipe a piece left or right to trade it with its neighbour, or tap it and then the piece beside it. Three or more of a kind in a line clear, and the pieces below rise to fill the gap.
swap.how_to_keyboard: Arrows move the cursor. Space picks the piece up, then left or right swaps it. Escape lets it go.
swap.stage.runs_intro: Line up three or more of a kind to clear them. Longer runs are worth more.
swap.stage.chains_intro: A clear that sets off another is worth more each step, groups cleared together pay a bonus, and scoring swaps in a row build a streak.
swap.stage.specials_intro: A Spark Charge clears the pieces round where it lands. A Magnet clears every piece of the kind it is swapped with.
swap.stage.full_intro: Slag cannot be matched. It comes off once it rides above the heat line, and several at once is the big moment. Every swap raises the heat and every point vents it.
